project.title: profiling population-level diversity and dynamics of Accumulibacter via high throughput sequencing of ppk1
project.description: We introduced a pipeline to analyze the population-level diversity and dynamics of Accumulibacter via high throughput sequencing of ppk1 and rRNA gene.The approach was tested on the primer coverage, reproducibility and consistency with the clone library result.The pipeline is transplantable for studying microdiversity and niche differentiation of other functional microorganisms in complex microbial systems.
